description: Semantic duplicates between the 45 questions of polyglot-quiz milestone 1 (content/legacy) and the imported dataset. For each pair one record is kept and the other retired; references to a retired id (rounds, answers) are migrated to the kept id. Rule: keep the record with the better reviewed localization in all three languages. Imported OPEN-* records carry unreviewed machine-translated Ukrainian, so the authored legacy record is kept over them; hand-authored imported records are kept over the legacy ones.
reviewedBy: manual review of keyword and answer matches, 2026-11-27
